derivation: from G2596 (κατά) and a derivative of G4192 (πόνος);
def: to labor down, i.e. wear with toil (figuratively, harass)

occurrences.text: And seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him that was oppressed, and smote the Egyptian:
And delivered just Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked:
